findings.severity: MEDIUM (blocks whole acceptance of the per-kind continuation table; retained from Rev7, missed by review 97bb)
findings.area: TERMINAL_FRAME continuation liveness is Node-wide, not per matched claim
findings.statement: lifecycle._legacy_parent_current (used for TERMINAL_FRAME/BUILD_CLEANUP_READ) checks claimRights[original claim] lease/notAfter and the Node booleans leaseActive/workloadActive, but never that the matched claim is still in activeClaims, its claim version, or the parent row state. confirm(TERMINAL_CLEAN) discards the claim from activeClaims and recomputes the booleans from ALL remaining claims, and never removes claimRights. With any other claim on the Node (the fixture seeds claim-1), a TERMINAL_FRAME for the released command is registered and invoked.
findings.counterexample: reviewer-tf-released-claim-probe-result.jsonl.txt: parent EXECUTE -> confirm TERMINAL_CLEAN (CONFIRMED_OUTCOME, claim released) -> register+invoke TERMINAL_FRAME succeeds in BOTH immutable Rev7 and Rev8. Rev8 adds a second release path: exact CANCEL TERMINAL_CLEAN releases the claim while the parent stays PENDING_IO, and the frame is still admitted (PLAIN and B). Control: with no other claim on the Node the frame refuses.
findings.actual72028: terminal.py:_current requires run state running, current attempt, not_after > now+5s and every inv.resource_leases row of THIS run unreleased and unexpired (lines 65-93). The proposal is weaker than the existing product guard, so implementing it as specified would regress plain behaviour.
findings.remedy: Per-claim liveness: on release tombstone claimRights[claim] (or bind a claim version at parent admission and require equality); require original claim in activeClaims, parent row PENDING_IO with LIVE current-incarnation cap for TERMINAL_FRAME, and per-claim lease/workload state instead of Node booleans. Decide BUILD_CLEANUP_READ explicitly (it shares the predicate). Regressions: frame after parent TERMINAL_CLEAN, after CANCEL receipt release, with and without other Node claims, per-claim lease expiry while other claims are live; keep DRAIN-only exception unchanged.
